summary: Machine learning engineer with 8 years of experience building production ML systems. Specialized in NLP, recommendation engines, and MLOps pipelines. Strong publication record and open-source contributions.

experience.title: Senior ML Engineer
responsibilities: Built a real-time recommendation engine processing 2.8B events/day using Spark Streaming and custom TensorFlow Serving infrastructure.
Designed an A/B testing framework for ML models, reducing experiment cycle time from 3 weeks to 4 days.
Led the MLOps initiative: implemented model versioning (MLflow), automated retraining pipelines (Kubeflow), and feature stores (Feast).
Published internal research on efficient fine-tuning of LLMs for domain-specific classification tasks.

experience._grey_area: TITLE INFLATION — The title 'Head of AI' at a 4-person startup is ambiguous
experience.title: Head of AI
responsibilities: Sole ML practitioner at a seed-stage startup. Built the entire ML stack from scratch.
Developed a text classification pipeline for contract analysis using BERT fine-tuning.
Managed no direct reports. The 'Head of' title was self-assigned as the only technical hire.
Company failed to secure Series A and shut down in Q1 2022.
experience.notes: Title 'Head of AI' is misleading — the candidate was the only ML/AI person at a 4-person company. No leadership or management experience from this role.
